rule_condition: The 120-point shield absorbs damage first. No resistance or other damage modifier applies; any remaining damage reduces health.
battle_description: At the start of the event, Vale has 820 of 1,200 health and a 120-point shield, with no active control effect. Ilyra hits Vale with Arc Lance, a skill that deals 300 magic damage and roots the target for 1.2 seconds. Shields absorb incoming damage before health; there is no resistance or other damage modifier.
transition_summary: Arc Lance deals 300 damage: the shield absorbs 120 and is depleted, while health falls from 820 to 640. Vale remains alive and is rooted for 1.2 seconds.
